hook: Fluid flow does not lower the 4π mass threshold for Keller-Segel blow-up, settling an open conjecture
summary: In a model of cells attracted to a chemical they emit while carried by a fluid, the authors prove that every initial mass below 4π gives a unique global bounded solution in two dimensions. This answers a question left open since earlier work reached only 2π. The proof builds a new quasi-energy inequality from isoperimetric estimates and rearrangement. It covers the subcritical side and bounded planar domains only.
title: On the optimal mass threshold for the two-dimensional Keller-Segel system coupled to the Navier-Stokes equations
